headline: Agent Skill Generates Interactive Isometric Visuals of Systems
body: Anatomy is an agent capability that builds interactive isometric visuals of intricate systems and machinery. It produces refined SVGs with optional 3D styling and WebGL shaders.
caption:
Agent Skill Generates Interactive Isometric Visuals of Systems

Anatomy is an agent capability that builds interactive isometric visuals of intricate systems and machinery. It produces refined SVGs with optional 3D styling and WebGL shaders.
